# Avatar

> Profile image with initials fallback and composable overlapping groups.

This file matches the installed `avatar` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/avatar.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/avatar.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/avatar-knobs`: `avatarKnobs`, types `AvatarKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/avatar`: `avatarBadgeStatuses`, `Avatar`, `AvatarGroup`, `AvatarImage`, `AvatarFallback`, `AvatarBadge`, types `AvatarProps`, `AvatarGroupProps`, `AvatarImageProps`, `AvatarFallbackProps`, `AvatarBadgeStatus`, `AvatarBadgeProps`

## Composition

### Avatar group

```tsx
<AvatarGroup>
  <Avatar>
    <AvatarImage />
    <AvatarFallback />
    <AvatarBadge />
  </Avatar>
</AvatarGroup>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { Avatar, AvatarBadge, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, AvatarImage } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/avatar";

export function PrimitiveAvatarExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-5">
      <AvatarGroup aria-label="Project contributors">
        <Avatar>
          <AvatarImage src="https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494790108377-be9c29b29330?w=128&h=128&dpr=2&q=80" alt="Ada Lovelace" />
          <AvatarFallback>AL</AvatarFallback>
          <AvatarBadge status="online" label="Online" />
        </Avatar>
        <Avatar>
          <AvatarFallback>DS</AvatarFallback>
          <AvatarBadge status="away" label="Away" />
        </Avatar>
        <Avatar>
          <AvatarFallback>GH</AvatarFallback>
        </Avatar>
      </AvatarGroup>
      <Avatar size="lg">
        <AvatarFallback>CU</AvatarFallback>
        <AvatarBadge status="busy" label="Busy" />
      </Avatar>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `avatar`
  - `badge`: `data-status` (`away` | `busy` | `offline` | `online`)
  - `fallback`
  - `group`
  - `image`: `data-ending-style`, `data-error`, `data-loading`, `data-starting-style`
  - `root`: `data-size` (`lg` | `md` | `sm` | `xs`)

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### avatar

- `--cui-avatar-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 9)`
- `--cui-avatar-radius`: `9999px`
- `--cui-avatar-group-gap`: `calc(var(--spacing) * -2)`
- `--cui-avatar-group-ring-size`: `2px`
- `--cui-avatar-group-ring-color`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-avatar-fallback-background`: `var(--muted)`
- `--cui-avatar-fallback-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-avatar-image-outline-color`: `var(--image-outline)`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-size`: `max(0.5rem, 30%)`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-radius`: `9999px`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-ring-size`: `2px`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-ring-color`: `var(--background)`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-background`: `var(--primary)`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-foreground`: `var(--primary-foreground)`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-online-background`: `var(--success)`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-away-background`: `var(--warning)`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-busy-background`: `var(--destructive)`
- `--cui-avatar-badge-offline-background`: `oklch(from var(--muted-foreground) l c h / 0.6)`
